speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: You are seeking approval for the questions to be responded to later?

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: Deputy Leader, let me draw your attention to Standing Order 22(4), which states, "If a Minister, Parliamentary Secretary or other Member, who is to answer a question, is absent, the question shall, if he then be present, be taken after all other questions appearing on the 	Page: 6 Order Paper have been disposed of." This basically means that he can only respond to the questions after Question No 61 has been disposed of.

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: Is there any other Member present who can answer these questions?

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: If not, I will have to move on to Question No 5.
